svg.text: Versarite MView 1.0 — how the units work together at run time

Bands are threads. Only the UI thread touches the window; the other threads hand results back with TThread.Queue (blue). Numbers follow the path of one image, from a mouse click to the screen. NEW: added since Day 19.
